test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who was the Chief guest on 26th January 2023 Republic Day Parade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdel Fattah El Sisi.**__

The Question is about **2023**. In 2024 **President Emmanuel Macron (France)** was the chief guest on Republic Day Parade.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abdel Fattah El Sisi:-**

 
 
• **Abdel Fattah El Sisi is the current President of Egypt, having assumed office in 2014.**
 
• **He was the Chief guest on 26th January 2023 Republic Day Parade.**
 
• As the Chief guest on India's Republic Day Parade, he would have been accorded a ceremonial welcome and given the opportunity to witness India's military might and cultural diversity on display.
 
• India invites a prominent world leader as the Chief guest for its Republic Day Parade every year, and this is seen as a gesture of friendship and diplomatic outreach.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cyril Ramaphosa:-**

 
 
• He is the current President of South Africa, and he was the Chief guest at India's Republic Day Parade in 2019.
 
 
 
• **Shinzo Abe:-**
 
 
• He is a former Prime Minister of Japan who served in that role from 2012 to 2020. He was the Chief guest at India's Republic Day Parade in 2014 and again in 2018.
 
 
 
• **Jair Bolsonaro:-**
 
 
• He is the current President of Brazil, having taken office in 2019. He has not yet been invited as the Chief guest for India's Republic Day Parade.
